analyst.summary: L&T enters FY27 with a record ~Rs 7.40 lakh crore order book (~2.6x FY26 revenue) and a genuinely improving core balance sheet (deleveraging, working capital at a multi-year low), but FY26 revenue growth (12%) missed its own 15% guidance, FY27 guidance was cut to 10-12% with flat margins, and sell-side EPS estimates have been trimmed 8-10% post-Q4 on Middle East-linked execution disruption expected to persist through H1 FY27. The price weakness looks mostly like a sector-wide capital-goods de-rating (L&T actually outperformed its sector over the past year) layered with a real, near-term, company-guided-transient execution/margin wobble -- not a fundamental breakdown. At ~32x trailing earnings the valuation prices in more growth than current guidance supports, leaving limited margin of safety into the July 28 Q1 FY27 print, but with no balance-sheet or governance red flags and a record backlog underpinning multi-year revenue visibility, the call is Hold, not Sell.
